resources.string: You’re not connected to the internet. Check your Wi-Fi or network and try again.
Something went wrong. Try again, and if it keeps happening, try your backup server address.
The server took too long to answer. Check your internet connection and try again. If it keeps happening, try your backup server address.
That server address couldn’t be found. Check it’s typed exactly as you were given it, starting with http:// and with no / at the end.
The server couldn’t be reached or cut the connection. Your internet provider may be blocking it: try your backup server address, or turn on a VPN and use your VPN server address.
The download was cut off part-way. Try again. If it keeps happening, try your backup server address.
Your username or password isn’t right. Re-enter them exactly as you were given them: they’re case-sensitive and have no spaces. On a VPN? Use your VPN server address.
There’s no IPTV server at that address. Check the server address is typed exactly, with no / at the end.
The server is having problems right now. It’s usually back within minutes. If it keeps happening, try your backup server address.
The server didn’t accept a secure connection. If your server address starts with https://, change it to http:// and try again.
Your username or password isn’t right. Re-enter them exactly as you were given them: they’re case-sensitive and have no spaces.
This subscription has ended. Renew it with your provider: your login stays the same.
Couldn’t reach the server. Check your internet connection and the server address, or try your backup server address.
This channel isn’t responding. It may be offline right now. Try another channel, or try again in a minute.
Lost connection to this channel. Check your internet, then press Retry. If it keeps dropping, try your backup server address.
You’re not connected to the internet. Check your Wi-Fi or network and try again.
This channel or title couldn’t be played. It may be offline right now, or your playlist is playing on another device (it works on one at a time). %1$s
Your playlist is already playing on another device. It works on one device at a time, so stop it there, then press Retry.
This stream didn’t start. It may be offline right now. Try another channel, or try again in a minute.
